meta.title: Quantity can be edited directly in the cart

steps.note: Open the purchase-request flow containing the cart line items.
Use an open purchase request that can be started as a project.
Select one PR line so its cart quantity can be edited.
Open the selected purchase items and start the project flow where the cart is available.

args.goal: Open the PR line-item cart side panel, click the quantity box for a line, enter a value lower than that line's requested quantity, and stop with the cart line showing the edited quantity.

steps.note: Perform the direct cart edit and confirm on screen that the lower quantity is accepted and displayed.
Assert that the edited cart still exposes the quantity field on the resulting screen.
